title: Narrative Intents
description: Intent categories used by the narrative reasoning layer.

entries.title: Informative
entries.description: The text informs rather than persuades.

entries.title: Historical
entries.description: The text frames material as history.

entries.title: Documentary
entries.description: The text reports or documents events.

entries.title: Fictional
entries.description: The text is framed as invented storytelling.

entries.title: Symbolic
entries.description: The text uses symbols to carry meaning.

entries.title: Story Endorsement
entries.description: The story appears to endorse a meaning.

entries.title: Story Reversal
entries.description: A later scene reverses an earlier impression.
